reviews.title: AI Great performance for LLM
reviews.comment: I am not using this for gaming. For the money spent, under 3 benjis, 12GB VRAM for LLM is a great value especially for the performance. I chided myself for not getting the last two available. I did end  up getting another thru BAY of the E. 24GB VRAM for under 6 benjamins aint shabby My AI test rig isnt anything special. In fact its ancient. Its a MSI Z97 Gaming 5 board with 32GB DDR3 ram, a 4th gen Intel i5 haswell chip. So PCI-Express 3. I am able to run 27B LLMs with ease.
reviews.author: 00SubZero00

reviews.title: Great card for the price
reviews.comment: Great card, I bought it "renewed" and it was unused in the original box. haven't had any issues with it and have ran all my games at 1440 with no issues
reviews.author: Quinn mckinney

reviews.title: Great LLM Card
reviews.comment: Very compact, easy to install, make almost no noise under load and performs quite well for a little LLM machine. I'm sure it's also great for gaming as well, but the 12GB on this card works fantastic for inference.
